results.what: Genus-2 curve in Rosenhain normal form, branch points 0, 1, 1/κ², 1/λ², 1/μ², ∞. Real-axis tables of half-period values of the normalized integrals u_1, u_2, written through the nomes p, q (½ log p, ½ log q, cπ/2). References are to Rosenhain's memoir.
results.modern_name: Rosenhain normal form; period matrix of a real genus-2 hyperelliptic curve

results.what: Jump of log ϑ − log ϑ' across the cuts of the dissected surface, equal to the Abel sums of the zeros (α, β) minus a period modulus a_{1,1} or a_{1,2}
results.modern_name: Monodromy of theta quotients; Riemann's zero theorem / Abel–Jacobi bookkeeping

results.what: Linear system of plane cubics with a double point at a given point (α, α'). Three conditions eliminate a30, a03, a00, leaving f·α²α'² = Σ a_ij P_ij with each P_ij vanishing to order 2 at the point.
results.modern_name: Linear system of nodal cubics (cubics singular at a point); polar conditions for a singular point

results.what: Coefficient expansion of the cube of a binary quartic ax⁴+4bx³+6cx²+4dx+e, with attempted eliminations among the coefficients of the degree-12 product
results.modern_name: Binary forms / conditions for a form to be a perfect power (classical invariant theory)

deep.surprise_reason: Everything on the page is routine working material. It consists of reading notes on Rosenhain's genus-2 theory, standard theta-jump bookkeeping of the kind Riemann published in 1857, an elementary elimination for cubics with a node, and a hand expansion of a cube. Nothing anticipates a later named result.

transcription_corrections: Header: '∞ > κ² > λ² > μ²' is likely '1 > κ² > λ² > μ²', given the branch-point order 0, 1, 1/κ², 1/λ², 1/μ².
a_{2,0} line: the middle term should read −2𝔷³αα'² (not αα'³), as the elimination requires.
a_{0,2} line: the middle term is −2𝔷'³α²α' (not α³α').
First cubic line: the cross terms 3a_{2,1}𝔷²𝔷' + 3a_{1,2}𝔷𝔷'² are missing or garbled in the machine transcription; the image shows a_{0,3}𝔷'³ and 3a_{2,0}𝔷² after a_{3,0}𝔷³.
Second row of the cube expansion: '+12ab²' should be checked against the image; the correct coefficient is 3·16 ab² = 48ab² (possibly an overwritten numeral).
The 'p. 409 / 417 / 434' references most plausibly point to Rosenhain's memoir (Mém. Sav. Étrangers XI, pp. 361-468); 'ϑ(r over r,s)(v,w)' is a theta with characteristic in Rosenhain-type notation.
Lower right: '(4·36 a²c − 4·64 ab²)d' may read '(4·36 a²c − 9·64 ab²)d' with a strike-through; uncertain.
